groups.title: Custom Fabrication
groups.summary: One-off prototypes through production runs in aluminum, stainless and steel, fabricated in-house with documented quality.

about.title: A Houston shop that keeps the whole job under one roof.
text: JK Welding is a locally owned and operated Houston shop specializing in aluminum, stainless, and steel fabrication for commercial and industrial projects across Texas. From design support and cutting to welding and finishing, we complete work in-house for precision, consistency, and faster turnarounds.

Keeping nearly everything under one roof reduces handoffs, protects surface quality, and shortens lead times. You get a single point of accountability from drawings to finished parts and a team that collaborates daily on geometry, fixtures, and inspection.
about.imageAlt: A fabricated steel platform and railing assembly built by JK Welding

facts.heading: Welder Certifications
facts.text: Our welders are AWS, DNV, and Section IV certified and follow controlled procedures matched to your specification. We inspect at the right stages so parts arrive consistent and ready to use.

facts.heading: Processes We Run In-House
items: Cutting: fiber laser, CNC plasma, saw cutting, part prep and deburr
Forming and fixturing: press brake, jigs, in-process inspection for repeatability
Welding: TIG for fine detail, MIG for production strength
Finishing: brushed and polished stainless, paint or coating coordination as required
Assembly and QC: documented checkpoints to keep geometry and finish on spec

facts.heading: Industries We Serve
facts.text: Oil and gas, industrial and OEM, medical, commercial, and architectural projects across Texas. We also fabricate for food service, building, manufacturing, and public works projects.

facts.heading: Field Service At Your Site
facts.text: JK Welding also provides full-service welding and fabrication field service at your site, serving a wide range of industries with both in-shop fabrication and mobile field welding, including on-site installation and emergency repair work.

items: Design and engineering: your concept turned into detailed plans and specifications ready for fabrication

facts.text: Tough, complex, or unusual projects are welcome, and we have a reputation for accepting the larger, harder, and bigger projects. Bring a CAD file, a drawing or just a description, and our design team can work up a first draft and offer concepts and ideas.
